info.name: FlashArray REST Active Directory File System Junctions API

params.name: allow_errors
params.description:
If set to `true`, the API will allow the operation to continue even if there are errors.
Any errors will be returned in the `errors` field of the response.
If set to `false`, the operation will fail if there are any errors.

params.name: context_names
params.description:
Performs the operation on the unique contexts specified.

If specified, each context name must be the name of an array in the same fleet or
the name of the fleet itself.

If not specified, the context will default to the array that received this request.

Other parameters provided with the request, such as names of volumes or snapshots,
are resolved relative to the provided `context`.

Enter multiple names in comma-separated format.
For example, `name01,name02`.

params.name: continuation_token
params.description:
A token used to retrieve the next page of data
with some consistency guaranteed.
The token is a Base64 encoded value.
Set `continuation_token` to the system-generated token taken from the `x-next-token`
header field of the response.
A query has reached its last page when the response does not include a token.
Pagination requires the `limit` and `continuation_token`
query parameters.

params.name: destination_file_system_ids
params.description:
A comma-separated list of destination file system IDs. If after filtering,
there is not at least one resource that matches each of the elements,
then an error is returned. This cannot be provided together with the
`destination_file_system_names` query parameter.

params.name: destination_file_system_names
params.description:
A comma-separated list of destination file system names. If there is not
at least one resource that matches each of the elements, then an error
is returned. This cannot be provided together with `destination_file_system_ids`
query parameter.

params.name: filter
params.description:
Narrows down the results to only the response objects
that satisfy the filter criteria.

params.name: ids
params.description:
A comma-separated list of resource IDs.
If after filtering, there is not at least one resource that matches
each of the elements of `ids`, then an error is returned.
This cannot be provided together with the `name` or `names` query parameters.

params.name: limit
params.description:
Limits the size of the response to the specified number of objects on each page.
To return the total number of resources, set `limit=0`.
The total number of resources is returned as a `total_item_count` value.
If the page size requested is larger than the system maximum limit,
the server returns the maximum limit, disregarding the requested page size.

params.name: names
params.description:
Performs the operation on the unique names specified.
Enter multiple names in comma-separated format.
For example, `name01,name02`.

If there is not at least one resource that matches
each of the elements of `names`, then an error is returned,
except when creating new resources.

params.name: offset
params.description: The offset of the first resource to return from a collection.

params.name: origin_file_system_ids
params.description:
A comma-separated list of origin file system IDs. If after filtering,
there is not at least one resource that matches each of the elements,
then an error is returned. This cannot be provided together with the
`origin_file_system_names` query parameter.

params.name: origin_file_system_names
params.description:
A comma-separated list of origin file system names. If there is not
at least one resource that matches each of the elements, then an error
is returned. This cannot be provided together with `origin_file_system_ids`
query parameter.

params.name: sort
params.description:
Sort the response by the specified fields (in descending order if '-'
is appended to the field name).
NOTE: If you provide a sort you will not get a `continuation_token` in
the response.

params.name: context_names
params.description:
Performs the operation on the context specified.

If specified, the context names must be an array of size 1, and the single element
must be the name of an array in the same fleet or the name of the fleet itself. If
not specified, the context will default to the array that received this request.

Other parameters provided with the request, such as names of volumes or snapshots,
are resolved relative to the provided `context`.

params.name: names
params.description:
Performs the operation on the unique resource names specified.
Only one value is supported.

params.name: origin_file_system_ids
params.description:
A comma-separated list of origin file system IDs. Only one value is supported.
This cannot be provided together with the `origin_file_system_names` query parameter.

params.name: origin_file_system_names
params.description:
A comma-separated list of origin file system names. Only one value is supported.
This cannot be provided together with `origin_file_system_ids` query parameter.

params.name: use_existing_directory
params.description:
This parameter must be set to `true` if junction is created
on an existing empty directory. Otherwise, it is assumed that
junction directory doesn't exist and a new directory will
be created.
